title: Function workflow
description: One recurring piece of a function's work, at packages/naive/src/functions/<id>/workflows/<workflow id>.json: what starts it, the steps the function's agent takes, the records each step writes through the router, the decision classes a step may raise, the activity a step performs, whether a step is required or one to consider, and the done criteria in the handoff's form (handoff.schema.json done_criteria), so a workflow run can be handed off and verified like any other work. Every route a step writes must be in the function's write reach, and every class it raises must have a row in the function's decisions.json and every activity a step names must be an APQC activity or a catalog activity under the function's APQC category, and every workflow has at least one required step (packages/naive/src/checks/check-functions.ts).

kind.description: intake: once, when the function joins a venture, and again when its records are missing. schedule: on a cadence. event: when a route is written. request: when a lead or person hands it off.

route.description: For event: the route pattern whose write starts it.

reads.description: Route patterns the agent reads first.

do.description: What the agent does, in one plain sentence.

skill.description: A skill in the function's skills/ folder to load for this step.

ask.description: True when the step asks the person, because only they know the answer.

raises.description: Decision classes this step may raise.

consider.description: Present when the step is one to consider, not one the workflow requires (EE-181). The agent runs it only when `when` holds, or when a person asks, and otherwise reports that it considered the step and why it did not run it. A step without `consider` is required: the agent runs it or raises a decision.

why.description: Why a person might want this step, in one plain sentence.

when.description: The condition under which the agent runs the step without being asked, in one plain sentence. Without it, only a person's ask runs the step.

activity.description: The activity this step performs: the hierarchy id of an APQC level 4 activity in packages/naive/src/functions/pcf.json, such as 3.5.1.6, or the id of an activity in packages/naive/src/functions/activities.json. It must sit under the function's APQC category.
